WITH c AS (
    INSERT INTO customers (name, email, last_contact_at)
    VALUES (NULLIF($1, ''), $2, now())
    ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE
    SET last_contact_at = now(),
        name = COALESCE(customers.name, EXCLUDED.name)
    RETURNING *
)
SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name, c.email, c.language, c.country, c.marketing_opt_in,
       (SELECT string_agg(w.brand || ' ' || w.reference || ' (' || to_char(p.sold_at, 'YYYY-MM') || ')', ', ')
          FROM purchases p JOIN watches w ON w.id = p.watch_id
         WHERE p.customer_id = c.id) AS past_purchases,
       (SELECT string_agg(ci.brand || COALESCE(' ' || ci.reference, ''), ', ')
          FROM customer_interests ci WHERE ci.customer_id = c.id) AS known_interests,
       (SELECT json_agg(s) FROM (
            SELECT id AS stock_no, brand, model, reference, year, condition, box_papers,
                   ask_usd AS price_usd, location_country, auth_status
            FROM watches
            WHERE status = 'in_stock' AND auth_status IN ('ai_checked', 'watchmaker_verified')
            ORDER BY created_at DESC
            LIMIT 40) s) AS inventory,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'business_name') AS business_name,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'owner_email') AS owner_email,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'from_email') AS from_email,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'large_deal_usd') AS large_deal_usd,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'auto_send_replies') AS auto_send_replies
FROM c;

WITH i AS (
    INSERT INTO inquiries (customer_id, from_email, subject, body, ai_reply, needs_human, human_reason, status)
    VALUES ($1::INT, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::BOOLEAN, $7, $8)
    RETURNING id
),
lang AS (
    UPDATE customers SET language = COALESCE(NULLIF($9, ''), language) WHERE id = $1::INT
),
interests AS (
    INSERT INTO customer_interests (customer_id, brand, reference, source)
    SELECT $1::INT, x.brand, NULLIF(x.reference, ''), 'inquiry'
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($10::jsonb) AS x(brand TEXT, reference TEXT)
    WHERE COALESCE(x.brand, '') <> ''
    ON CONFLICT (customer_id, lower(brand), lower(coalesce(reference, ''))) DO NOTHING
)
SELECT id AS inquiry_id FROM i;

parameters.content:
## Personalized replies
Every new email is answered by Claude **in the customer's language**, using your real stock list. The customer is added to the database and their interests are saved (for alerts and campaigns).

**Human only:** payment, receipts, discounts, negotiation and deals above `large_deal_usd` go to you. The customer gets a polite holding reply.

Set `auto_send_replies` to `false` to review every reply first. "STOP" unsubscribes the customer.
